pokedexEntries.ru: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This POKéMON flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.

pokedexEntries.sa: MASQUERAIN’s antennas have eyelike patterns that usually give it an angry look. If the “eyes” are droopy and appear sad, it is said to be a sign that a heavy rainfall is on its way.

pokedexEntries.frlg: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

pokedexEntries.em: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can’t fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction--to and fro and sideways.

pokedexEntries.mo: Its wings and antennae don’t cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.

pokedexEntries.us: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns of its eyespots. If that doesn’t work, it deftly makes its escape on its set of four wings.

pokedexEntries.um: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.
